Commentary.Commentary: Hazlewood and Lyon shone for the Aussies with 7 wickets between them. AUSTRALIA HAVE NOT ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON. Quite expected as the visitors ate up an hour today, adding 44 runs as well. The Aussie innings isn't far away.

Australia have taken a massive 223-run lead. Younis Khan's splendid unbeaten ton was the highlight of this innings with Azhar too stroking a fifty. The former remained unbeaten as he ran out of partners. If it wasn't for Younis' heroics and his shepherding of the tail, things may have been disastrous for Pakistan as other batsmen failed.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! That's a real peach, too good for a tailender. Fuller just around off, tails in sharply as Imran is late to bring his bat down. Sneaks through the gap between bat and pad to disturb the timber. Beautiful bowling, Hazlewood has a 4-fer to his name. PAKISTAN HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 315.
Full and outside off, defended well off the front foot.
IMRAN KHAN is the last man in.

OUT! GONE! Hazlewood breaks the partnership. Good length on fourth stump line, a bit of extra bounce as Yasir pushes tamely at it. The outside edge flies straight to Smith who takes a comfortable catch at second slip. Ends a valuable 51-run stand for Pakistan. More than the runs added, the time spent by the duo has more or less ensured that Australia may not enforce the follow-on even if they get the chance.

SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Floated outside off, Younis steps out to that one and makes room to pummel it inside out over the covers for a flat maximum. Terrific shot from the veteran maestro. He continues to motor along at high speed. The deficit continues to narrow down.
Flatter on leg stump, gets back and clips it to square leg.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards cover. Single taken.
Floated outside off, leans forward and defends it well.
Flatter on off, swept hard down to fine leg. Denies the single.
FOUR! Flighted outside off, YK gives the charge for the lofted stroke and skies it towards long off. Mid off was up and so it was always going to the fence. Warner gives chase but in vain.
Pitched up around off, bunted strongly towards mid on.
Good length outside off, extra bounce as Yasir lets it pass.
Forward short leg comes in.
Dug in short but down the leg side, easily left alone.
Fuller on middle and off, gets across and jams it towards short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven fluently to cover-point as Lyon makes a good half-stop with a dive. Single taken.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and defends it.
Loopy outside off, stays back and defends firmly.
Floated around off, blocked firmly from the crease.
Flatter around off, Yasir is rapped on the front pad and there is a mild lbw appeal. There was a tiny inside edge there.
Quicker ball on off, Younis sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up fuller around off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
Flighted on off, leans across to that one and blocks.
STEPHEN O'KEEFE comes into the attack.
Fuller outside off, nicely bunted towards mid off.
Length ball on middle, gets across and tucks it to the leg side.
Full and wide outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards extra cover. Single taken.
Fuller on off, leans across and drives it sweetly towards mid on.
Another good length ball on the fourth stump line, no stroke offered.
Length ball angled in from outside off, blocked firmly from the crease.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD comes on to bowl for the first time today.
Floated on middle and leg, Younis reaches out and chips it just past mid-wicket for a single. 300 comes up for Pakistan.
Slightly short outside off, punched to extra cover for a single.
On a length outside off, pushed through the covers for a brace.
Flatter outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Floated outside off, driven down to long off. Takes the single this time off just the second ball of the over.
Tossed up outside off, swept away to deep square leg. There was a brace in the offing but strangely, no run taken.
Fuller outside off, Yasir tries to dig it out but cannot.
Back of a length outside off, Shah makes the leave as an afterthought.
And again! Almost a replica of the previous ball. Another good length ball outside off at 150 kph, Yasir looks to feel for it without any footwork and is beaten. Starc is cranking it up.
Play and a miss! Good length outside off, tailing away a bit as Yasir is beaten on the drive.
Shortish outside off, Yasir gets a bottom edge that rolls towards gully.
Good length angled in on off stump, solidly blocked from the crease.
Darted on leg stump, YK clips it straight to backward square leg.
Floated wider outside off, Younis reaches out and pushes it towards point. Cannot get the run.
Loopy and wider outside off, YK mistimes the drive back to the bowler.
On a length on middle and leg, worked off the back foot past short leg for a single.
Loopy outside off, reaches out and taps it to the off side.
Full and around off, leans forward and blocks solidly.
Very full on middle and leg, propelled to mid-wicket. Won't get the single he was looking for.

FOUR! That's got through! Good length slanted across the right-hander, Younis pushes at it with an angled bat. The ball flies off the shoulder of the blade just past a diving gully fielder to the ropes.
Banged in short outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Back of a length on leg stump, Younis shuffles across and tucks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Very full and on the pads, whipped away to deep backward square leg. Doesn't take the single.
Full and angled away outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Loopy on off, Yasir steps out to play across the line but is rapped on the front pad. Polite lbw shout from the Aussies but the batsman was way down the pitch.
On a length around off, punched off the back foot to the bowler.
Drifting in from around off, uses his feet and taps it towards mid on.
Floats it up outside off, Yasir blocks it off the inside half of the bat.
Flighted outside off, presses forward and smothers it to the ground.
Tossed up outside off, leans into it and defends with a straight bat.
Good length angled away across Younis at 144 kph, ignored by the batsman.
Another short ball, this time around off, Younis once again ducks under it.
Banged in short around leg stump, YK ducks under the bumper.
Full and just outside off, nicely left alone to the keeper.
Almost carried! Back of a length angled away outside off, Younis stays on the back foot and plays it with an angled bat. Just short of a diving gully fielder.
Full on middle, gets across and drives it firmly to mid on.
Fuller on middle, worked on the leg side for a single to keep the strike.

SIX! CLOBBERED! Vintage Younis Khan! Tossed up invitingly around off, the veteran steps out and launches it deep into the stands at long on. Terrific shot to bring up his 150 - his 13th such instance in Tests. Loves making daddy tons, this man. What a knock this has been! Pakistan need 51 more to avoid the follow-on.
Flatter outside off, stays back and defends it solidly.

Mistimed...but falls safe! Drifting in from around off, Younis goes for the slog sweep, skews it high towards deep mid-wicket where it lands safe. A couple more runs added. Yasir is really struggling with his running.
Floated teasingly outside off, Younis gets the stride forward and defends.
Tossed up around off, leans into it and defends solidly.
Another full ball around off, Yasir does well to keep it out to mid off.
Full and angling into the stumps, Yasir jams it out towards mid on.
Full and outside off, bunted past the bowler towards mid off for a single.
Speared on the pads, whipped to deep square leg. Younis denies the single.
Fuller outside off, punchy drive towards extra cover. Mid off moves across to his left to make the stop.
Good length on middle and leg, YK gets across and tucks it to the leg side.
Stays behind the line and defends it with a solid straight bat.
Floated ball outside off, Yasir Shah keeps it out watchfully.
Drifting it in from around off, Khan nudges it towards square leg off the inner half of the bat for a single.
Tossed up around off, defended gently off the front foot.
Comes forward and pushes it away towards mid-wicket.
Flatter one around middle and leg, flicked towards square leg.
Yorker fired outside off, Yasir once again is beaten by pace there as he fails to jam this one out. A good tidy first over from Starc.
Comes from around the wicket and keeps it full outside off, Shah tries to slice it but is late to bring his bat down.

Edged and dropped! Matthew Wade has put it down! Starc almost gets a wicket. Very full and served wide outside off, Younis Khan tries to slice it through the off side but gets a thick outside edge towards Wade who dives full length to his right but fails to cling on to it. The ball rolls off his gloves and goes further which allows the batsmen to take the single. Chance goes down abegging.
Angles it in from around off, it's pushed down to mid on.

FOUR! Put away! Starc tries to keep it full but ends up bowling a low full toss outside off. Younis leans into it and caresses it through extra cover. Lyon comes across to his right but couldn't stop it from crossing the ropes. Good shot, Younis!
Starc comes steaming in from over the wicket and keeps it full outside off, Khan pats it back to Mitchell.
Mitchell Starc to bowl from the other end! Three slips and gully for him.
Tosses it up outside off, Yasir lunges forward and keeps it out gently.
Flatter one around middle, Khan presses forward to flick but it goes off the inner part of the bat past short leg for a single. It was in the air but evades the man at short leg.
Short fine leg comes in place to save the single...
Pushes it quicker through the air around middle, YK pushes it towards mid on for nothing.
Floated delivery outside off, Younis presses forward in defense.
On middle and off, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery around off, Khan gets forward and defends it down.

We are all set to get underway. The players and umpires have made their way out to the middle. Younis Khan and Yasir Shah will continue to bat for Pakistan. It shall be Nathan Lyon to start off with the bowling proceedings. Here we go!!!
...Day 4, Session 2...

UPDATE 0655 IST - The inspection is done and dusted but unfortunately the sun is out when it's time for LUNCH! Play will resume at normal scheduled time that is, 0740 IST, of course if the umpires feel that the outfield is safe to continue. Take some more break and come back to see what happens next...

UPDATE 0620 IST - The umpires did inspect the conditions and they have decided to conduct another one at 0645 IST. It's obvious they might take early lunch, still we are waiting for the official confirmation...

UPDATE 0540 IST - We have some good news for you! The rain has stopped and the covers are coming off. It will take some time to make the ground ready but we should get some play soon. Another news coming in is that there will be an inspection to be taken place at 0615 IST. Stay with us as we will keep you posted...
UPDATE 0515 IST - The heavy rain has lightened but the drizzle is steadily there. It's quite murky out there at the moment.

Update from the Australian camp is that Matthew Renshaw shall take no further part in this Test match due to concussion. He copped a blow on his helmet at short leg yesterday and had left the field later on due to headache. The 20-year old had also got struck on the grill while batting in the first innings. Let's hope he gets fine soon. Meanwhile, Matthew Wade has recovered from his illness and will take the field today.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the fourth day's play. Younis Khan stood between Australia and a really big first innings lead yesterday. If not for him, the tourists might have already been batting for the second time by now. The deficit is still 267 but it could have been a lot worse. How many more can he add with the last two wickets? Australia will want to finish off things quickly this morning. IT'S RAINING AT THE SCG. We shall have a delayed start. We'll bring you more updates along the way.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 1.....

It remains to be seen what will Steven Smith do from here on. Will he enforce the follow on if Pakistan fail to get the required 68 runs? Or will he bat for at least two more sessions before having a go at Pakistan again? In case you don't know, there will be an early start tomorrow at 0430 IST to cover up for the time and overs lost today. Join us for all the action from the penultimate day. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

However, the veteran Younis Khan will take this day as he finally managed to get a ton in Australia and is still out there unbeaten, eyeing a daddy hundred. He is left stranded at one end and would need the tail to wag around. On the other hand, the home side would look to wrap up the Pakistan innings quickly tomorrow.

Once that happened, Pakistan lost the plot as the home side kept picking wickets at regular intervals. Starc came back well with the second new ball while Hazlewood kept things tight with his probing lines and lengths. But it was Nathan Lyon who got able assistance from the pitch and made the ball do all the talking.

Another fabulous day for the Australians! The rain gods had their say in the morning which saw the first session getting completely washed out but then they showed mercy and didn't interrupt again. Younis and Azhar continued to fight from where they left off but a terrible mix up handed the Aussies a breakthrough.
Tossed up on the stumps, Yasir prods forward and defends it solidly. So, THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 3, PAKISTAN TRAIL BY 267 RUNS!
On the pads, Yasir Shah defends it well.
Outside off, Younis drives it towards covers for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Khan cuts it towards point.
Floated on the stumps, Khan drives it towards mid on.
Younis prods forward to defend it on the on side.
Stephen O'Keefe to bowl the final over before stumps...
Very full outside off, Yasir prods forward to defend it.
Floated outside off, Younis shuffles and works it down the leg side for a single.
Outside off, Younis flicks it in front of the forward short leg fielder.
Floated outside off, Shah stays deep in his crease and punches it through the cover region for a single.
FOUR! WHAT-A-SHOT! Tossed up outside off, Yasir Shah slogs it over the mid on region for a boundary.
Yasir Shah is the new man in!

OUT! CLEANED UP!  Tossed up outside off and Riaz goes to defend it with a big gap between his bat and pad. Lyon exploits it totally as he goes through the batsman's defense. A classic dismissal for every off spinner. Pakistan need 75 to avoid the follow on.
Dishes out a short ball on middle, Younis ducks to let that one sail over him to the keeper.
Angles in a length ball from outside off, Khan defends it down safely.
Good length ball on off, Younis gets across and defends it down.
Touch fuller and outside off, Riaz comes a bit forward and dabs it with soft hands wide of the man at gully for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Riaz hangs back in defense.
On a length and outside off, Wahab makes an easy leave to the keeper.
Younis gets in line of the ball and blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up on the stumps, Khan goes for a sweep and finds a top edge which falls safely in the deep at fine leg. A couple taken.
Khan stays deep in his crease to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, Younis goes for a reverse sweep but the ball hits the gloves and then the pads. So the appeal is denied by the umpire.
Younis prods forward and defends it.

On the pads, Younis tries to flick it but finds an inside edge which hits the pads and goes towards backward square leg. Riaz comes half way down the pitch but is sent back by Younis. Playing safe in the end.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Goodish length delivery outside off, Riaz goes for a drive again but the ball whizzes past his outside edge to the keeper.
Full into the stumps, Riaz drives it straight back to the bowler.
Angling into the pads from a length, Riaz goes for a straight drive but gets an inside edge into the pads.
Fuller outside off, Khan drives it towards the vacant cover region for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Younis shuffles across off to defend it.
Josh Hazlewood comes back into the attack.
On the pads, Khan flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Younis prods forward to defend it.
Riaz prods forward and drives it towards mid on for a single.

SIX! Mistimed but a biggie! Tossed up on the stumps, Riaz reaches out to the ball and slogs it over deep square leg for a maximum. A spectator tries hard to catch it and nearly falls on his face in the process.
Floated outside off, Riaz drives it towards covers.
Tossed up outside off, Riaz lunges forward and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Nathan Lyon comes in again for a bowl.
Full outside off, Younis punches it from deep in his crease to the off side.
On the pads, Younis stays in his crease and defends it towards mid on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, left alone.
On the pads, Younis flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
FOUR! On the pads, a poor delivery from Starc. Younis flicks it fine through the fine leg region for a boundary.
A good length delivery outside off, Younis covers his stumps and defends it.
Tossed outside off, Riaz lunges forward and pushes it towards covers.
A bit short outside off, Riaz cuts it towards point.
Riaz prods forward to defend it.
Floated outside off, Riaz lunges forward to defend it.
On the pads, Riaz defends it off his front foot.
Tossed up on the stumps, Khan sweeps it on the on side for a single.
Steven O'Keefe comes in for a bowl.
Length ball outside off which was always going wide of the stumps, left alone.
Full outside off, Younis drives it through covers for a single.
Short again into the body, Younis covers his stumps and stands tall to defend it towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, Younis shuffles across and tries to poke at it but luckily for him the ball flies past his outside edge.
Short into the body, Younis stands tall in his crease and defends it towards mid on.
Length ball on the stumps, Younis shuffles and blocks it towards mid off.
Riaz lunges forward and defends it off the front foot.

OUT! AMIR DEPARTS! Tossed up outside off and Amir attempts to go for a big shot. But he totally mistimes it and the ball goes towards Warner at mid off who takes a dolly. He won't drop those. 95 more required to avoid the follow on.
Short outside off, Amir stands deep in his crease to defend it.
Tossed outside off, Amir prods forward to defend it.
Amir gets in line of the delivery to defend it.

Tossed up on the stumps, which skidded after pitching. Amir who was deep in his crease to defend it got an inside edge on the pads and it just went past the stumps. Replays showed that the ball hit the pad first which no one noticed and would have been plumb had they reviewed it.
Nathan Lyon comes in for a bowl.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven with the full face of the bat towards mid off.
Good length delivery, curling in a bit, Khan defends it from within the crease.
Gets right behind the line and defends it with a solid straight bat.

Beaten! On a length and moves away a bit after pitching with some bounce on it. Younis hangs back to poke at it but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper. Waqar Younis on air says, it's doesn't matter if you have scored a ton but deliveries like these can threaten anyone.
Very full and once again hurled wide outside off, Younis doesn't play at it.
Sprays it too wide outside off to make Khan play at it.
A hammer is out to level the bowler's landing area.
Full length delivery into the stumps, Amir drives it straight to mid off.
Full and straight into the stumps, Amir gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Length ball, Amir drives it through mid off for a couple.
Angling into the pads from a full length, Amir gets hit on his pads but the ball is always going down the leg side. A mild appeal is denied.
Full and straight into the stumps, Younis gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
On a good length into the stumps, Khan has solidly defended it.
Way down the leg side, Amir tries to flick it but misses and the ball goes wide towards Warner who .
Full and straight on the stumps, Amir blocks it away towards mid on.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Mohammad Amir walks in next, replacing Sarfraz!

OUT! SARFRAZ WALKS BACK! Full delivery which was angling away from the stumps, Ahmed goes for a flashy drive and gets an outside edge straight into the hands of Jackson Bird (substitute) at gully who is having a good day on the field. Starc was always bowling at probing lengths and finally gets the reward. 100 runs needed more to avoid follow on.
Again a delivery way outside off, Ahmed lets that through to the keeper.
Too wide outside off, left alone.
Length ball outside off, Younis shuffles across and gets an inside edge high on his pads. A loud appeal is denied by the umpire.
Outside off, left alone.
Just a tad short outside off, Khan punches it towards the cover region.

Full delivery outside off, left alone.
Outswinging delivery pitched outside off, Ahmed punches it through covers for a single.

Attacking the stumps again, Khan flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full inswinging yorker, Khan has defended it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Full and outside off, Younis pushes the ball towards the point region.
FOUR! EDGED AND SAFE! Full outside off, Younis tries to poke at it and the ball finds the outside edge which flies right behind the third slip and gully for a boundary.
On the pads, Younis plays an elegant shot towards square leg where the fielder dives to stop the ball.
First ball up and Starc starts with a yorker, Khan has somehow managed to dig it out of danger.
Second new ball has been taken. Mitchell Starc is back in the attack to make first use of it.
Quicker and flatter through the air, defended well by Sarfraz.
On the pads, Sarfraz clips it towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
Floated on the stumps, Khan flicks it towards square leg for a single.
On the pads, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Flatter through the air, the ball misses both the bat and pad as he tries to sweep it and the ball runs away for a couple towards fine leg. 2 Byes taken.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Ahmed dances down the track to flick it over the fielder at mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slower delivery outside off, Khan drives it towards mid off for a single.
Outside off, Khan pushes it towards covers.
Tossed up outside off, Khan leans forward and drives it towards the cover region.

Renshaw was hit on the helmet a couple of overs back and now is walking off the field to receive some treatment. There is a short leg in place and it's debutant Hilton Cartwright who is stationed there...
Down the leg side, Khan goes to flick it but is unable to make contact.
Tossed up outside off, Sarfraz drives it through covers for a single.
Tossed up on the leg stump, Sarfraz sweeps it straight towards the forward short leg fielder.
Flatter one outside off, Khan opens the face and taps it towards the man at point.
Lyon bowls a loopy ball around off, YK offers a solid front foot defense.
Gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Top edge but Younis is safe again! Lyon bowls it quicker through the air around off, Younis skips down the track to go big down the ground but gets a top edge. There is no one at short third man as the ball falls safely. A single is taken.
Darts it around middle, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it up around off, Khan looks to push it but gets an inside edge past short leg. It stayed low as well and a single is taken in the end.
FOUR! Drops it short outside off, Ahmed is quick to get back and pull it wide of the man at mid on. Beats the fielder with ease and Sarfraz gets a boundary to his name.

Seeing Ahmed charging down the track, he fires it full on leg. Ahmed somehow manages to get some bat on it as the ball goes towards short leg. Renshaw fumbles a bit but no damage done as the Pakistan keeper is quick to get back in the crease.
Loopy ball around off, driven towards covers.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Renshaw has asked for a change of helmet as he's hit flush on it... Meanwhile, drinks are on the field.

Ouch! Tossed up ball outside off, Sarfraz Ahmed sits down on one knee and looks to sweep. Makes a terrific connection and Renshaw at short leg ducks instinctively but gets hit on the helmet, then on the shoulder and then the ball goes towards the man at short fine leg. He seems to be fine though. The commentators on air remind us that he got hit on the helmet by Amir yesterday when he was batting in the 90s. Then they show a pic of his batting helmet which has got a big dent due to it. Such blows could be very nasty and scary as well, phew1
Sliding in from around off, blocked out safely.
Floated ball around off, defended down gently.

FOUR! Top edge but safe! He has some luck going his way! Tosses it up around off, Younis once again goes down to sweep it. This time gets a big top edge towards square leg. 34th Test ton for Younis Khan, first ever in Australia!

FOUR! There it is! That will do for the veteran! He didn't have a ton in this part of the world and gets one here in what could be his last Test match in Australia. Loopy ball around middle, Younis Khan goes down and sweeps it off the meat of the bat through square leg for a boundary. The helmet comes off and he lets the acknowledgment sink in. He also becomes the first batsman to score Test centuries in all the 10 Test playing nations and UAE. Well done, Younis!
Outside off, defended down watchfully.
Flatter one around middle, tucked towards the leg side.
Comes down the track and drives it down the track.
Driven towards the mid on region.

OUT! Steven Smith has taken a blinder at first slip! Initially I thought he's given out LBW but replays show there was an inside edge. Tossed up delivery around off, Asad Shafiq prods forward to defend but gets a faint inside edge on the pads as the ball goes off Handscomb's pads and deflects further. But Steven Alert Smith at first slip quickly dives to his right and takes a one-handed screamer. Brilliant from the Aussie skipper and Pakistan have now lost half their side.
Down the leg side, Khan looks to sweep but fails to get any bat on it. The keeper fails as well as the batsmen cross. The umpire signals it as a bye. Still remains on 99!

Around middle and leg, tucked towards the on side.
Covers the line and lunges forward to defend it.

Pushed quicker through the air, Khan clips it towards backward square leg for a single. On 99 now!

SIX! Downtown! Tossed up delivery around off, Younis Khan gets down the track, is to the pitch of the ball and nails it over the long on fence for half a dozen. What a shot and is just two short of his first Test ton in Australia.
Floated delivery around off, defended down watchfully.
Flatter outside off, punched towards cover-point.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.

A loud shout for an LBW! Drifting in from around off, skidding through the surface, Younis presses forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Stephen turns back to appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. Smith and the bowler have a chat and the latter says, HE HAS HIT IT! The skipper goes with the bowler and doesn't take the review. Replays show it was bat first. Good call!
Once again comes down the track and pushes it towards covers.
Very full and fired outside off, jammed it towards cover-point for a single.

O'Keefe gives it a nice flight around middle, Younis Khan gets down the track to go big but fails to get it off the middle of the bat. Luckily it goes off the inside edge towards square leg. A single is taken.

Loopy ball around middle and leg, pushed towards the on side.
Makes a good stride forward and offers a solid front foot defense.
Eased towards mid on for a quick single.
Tossed up around off, Khan comes down the track and drives it towards covers.
Drops it short and a bit flat outside off, Shafiq camps back and cuts it behind point. Three runs added to the total.
Floated ball on the stumps, the veteran gets down and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Beaten! Angles in a length ball from outside off, Shafiq stays back to defend as the ball sneaks through the gap between his bat and pad and goes towards Handscomb.
Short leg comes in...
Fuller and angling in, worked away towards short mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on middle, Shafiq defends it with a straight bat.

Brings out the sweep but there is protection! Tossed up outside off, Khan fetches it from outside off and sends it towards backward square leg for a comfortable single.
Gets behind the line and blocks it out well again.
Flighted delivery around off, Khan defends it down again.
Prods forward to this loopy ball and defends it into the ground.

Fuller outside off, driven straight to the man at short extra cover.

In the channel outside off, Khan lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper.
Fuller on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Asad Shafiq is the new man in, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Lyon strikes and it's a complete brain fade from Misbah! How many times we have seen him getting out like this? Lyon floats it up around off, turns in a bit, Misbah sits down to bring out the desperate slog sweep. He gets the elevation but not the distance as the substitute fielder Jackson Bird takes a safe catch near the deep mid-wicket region. The Aussies strike early after the break, Pakistan trail by 360!

A loud shout for a catch! It's off the pads. Tossed up and gripping in with the angle, Misbah looks to flick but misses as the ball lobs off the pads towards short leg where Renshaw dives forward to take it with his right hand. They appeal but the umpire turns it down. Replays confirm it was off the pads.
Lunges forward to this full ball and defends it down.
Floats it up around off, Misbah tries to go for a big shot but the ball dips in front of him and he ends up hitting it towards mid on. A big one is on the cards for sure.
Loops it up around middle, Younis goes down and across and sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery around middle, Younis flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Nathan Lyon to bowl from the other end.

Short of a length ball on middle, tucked past short leg for nothing.

Good length ball on off, defended again from within the crease.
Touch fuller and outside off, Misbah stays in the crease and dabs it towards gully.
On a length and outside off, Misbah defends it off the front foot.

Welcome back for the final session. Minimum of 31 overs remaining in the day and let's see what happens next. Both the veterans Misbah and Younis stride out to the middle. Josh Hazlewood to start off with the bowling proceedings. Let's play...
...Day 3, Session 3...

A mixed session for both the teams as the Australians didn't do any damage with the ball. The only wicket they got was through a run out. Azhar Ali and Younis Khan were batting beautifully till the former got out after they both struck a partnership worth 146 runs. Misbah has come in and looked a bit rusty at the start but is now looking a bit settled. They still have a massive deficit and are in need of more partnerships. Join us in a while for the post-tea session to find out how this Test match pans out.
Floated on the stumps, Khan defends it well from the front foot. That's TEA ON DAY 3.

JUST IN - Matthew Wade has not only left the field but also has gone to the hotel. He had nausea and wasn't feeling well at all. Let's hope he recovers soon...

NOT OUT! Umpire's call ! Good length delivery outside off which nips in after pitching, Ali tries to flick it but misses and the ball hits the pads. There was a long appeal by the Australians and the umpire stood there undisturbed. Steven Smith had a talk with Josh and called for a review. Replays show the ball was pitched outside off, impact was in line and the most important thing - the ball was clipping the leg stump. So the on-field decision stays as it is.
Steven Smith has called in for a review for an LBW on Azhar Ali.

Finally we have play! The players are on the field and it's going to be Mitchell Starc to begin proceedings. Here we go...

It's the third day of the SCG Test which is celebrated as the Jane McGrath day and hence everything will turn pink to create awareness about breast cancer.

Hello and a warm welcome for the coverage of the final Test match between Australia and Pakistan. It's been a fantastic couple of days for Australia except the final session of the second day where Azhar Ali and Younis Khan managed to stick out a 120-run unbeaten stand. We will have to watch out how long these two can survive as the visitors still trail by 412 runs. Meanwhile, the START HAS BEEN DELAYED as it was raining a little while ago. Fortunately, it has cleared now and the umpires will be soon examining the conditions. Stay tuned for all the updates.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

Australia started the day positively and went on to post a big first innings total, powered by the century from Peter Handscomb and his useful partnerships with the lower order. Hazlewood caused a stir with his bowling picking up two wickets in an over. But that's all Australia managed today. The visitors will wish their batsmen keep playing like this in order to get back in the game while the Aussies will hope to come back roaring tomorrow. Join us at 0500 IST for the third day of the final Test. Until then, it's goodbye and take care. Cheers!

Pakistan have finally had a good session after a series of torrid sessions. Azhar Ali and Younis Khan have stabled the sinking ship by adding up an unbeaten 120-run partnership. Both the batsmen have got to their fifties and will hope to make their momentum count as they still have a big deficit to narrow down. Warner was in the middle of all the things which took place on the field as he missed a couple of run out chances and nearly caught a blinder at leg slip. Also there was an edge which was not spotted by the Aussie players and that handed a reprieve to Younis Khan.
Fuller in length and just outside off, Azhar Ali drives it firmly but finds the man at mid off. THAT'S STUMPS ON DAY 2!
FOUR! Too easy for Ali! Josh angles it in but ends up straying on the pads, Ali gets a bit across and flicks it elegantly through mid-wicket to find the fence.
Fuller in length and stays really low as Azhar offers no stroke to it. It goes on the bounce to Wade and there are Ooohhss and Aaahsss around the stadium.
Angles it in on the pads, flicked firmly through mid-wicket for a couple.

Around off, defended down watchfully.

Dropped! David Warner again! He's having a tough time out there. Was involved in two run out chances and now drops one too. Floated ball around leg, turning in with some bounce as Ali looks to work it towards the leg side off the back foot. It goes towards the leg slip off the inside edge as Warner initially moves to his left but the ball comes to his right. He tries to bring out his right hand at the last moment but fails to cling on to it. A huge reprieve for Azhar.
Tossed up outside off, driven through extra cover for a single.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another edge and through again! Good length ball outside off, Younis is squared up a bit as he gets an outside edge through gully for three.
25th Test fifty for Azhar Ali!

FIFTY! Azhar Ali continues his dream run of form! Good length delivery outside off, Ali looks to defend but gets it off the outer part of the bat that flies past a diving gully fielder. Lyon gives it a chase and the crowd is right behind him as he saves a run for his side. Ali gets three to his name and shows the bat in acknowledgement. Is another big one coming?
Gets across and clips it past the man at short mid-wicket for a couple.

TOLD YA! Shouts Wade from behind the stumps. Seems he knew Ali will go after it. Tosses it up around middle and leg, Ali comes down the track to go big over the leg side but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards square leg for a single.

100-run stand between Younis and Azhar!

33rd Test fifty for Younis Khan, 5th against the Aussies. What will catch your attention is that he has gone past the 1000-run mark in Australia without a single ton. He will be eyeing one this time around.

Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Starc hits the deck hard and it doesn't rise as much as Younis expected. He tries to sway away from the line but he fails to do so and gets hit flush on the chest.

Full and wide outside off, Younis reaches out to it and drives it hard towards the cover fielder.
On the pads, Ali flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Azhar drives it towards mid on.
Way down the leg side, Ali tries to flick it but is unable to make contact.
Angling into the pads, Ali leans forward and drives it towards mid on.
Tossed outside off, Khan gets to the line of the ball to defend it.
Khan lunges forward to defend that one.
FOUR! Floated outside off, Younis leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
A bit short and Khan defends it in front of short leg.
Tossed outside off, Younis leans forward and defends it.
Tossed up outside off, Ali flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Full ball outside off, Younis it towards mid on.
Short ball this time around, left alone by Khan.
Short and wide outside off, Ali punches it through covers beautifully. But there was a much more beautiful effort near the fence by Warner to stop the boundary. Three runs taken.
Back of a length outside off, Ali stands tall and punches it towards mid on.
On the pads, Ali flicks it elegantly towards mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Ali tries to flick it but is unable to make contact.
Here comes the debutant, Hilton Cartwright into the attack!
50-run stand between Younis and Ali!
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Tossed up outside off, Khan gets in line of the ball and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Floated outside off, Younis defends  it off the front foot.
Floated outside off, Younis prods forward to defend it
Tossed up outside off, Ali tries to flick it but finds a leading edge towards covers for a single.
Short and spinning in, Ali dances down the track to defend it.
Tossed outside off, Ali leans into it and drives it towards mid on.
Length ball on the stumps, Younis stays in his crease and defends it on the off side.
Short into the body, Younis Khan ducks under it.
Angling in from a length, Younis elegantly drives it past mid on for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Khan covers his stumps and let that go straight to the keeper.
Back of a length delivery outside off. Younis punches it through the cover region for a couple.
Length ball angling into the batsman, Khan stays put in his crease to defend it.
The umpires have a small chat with Skipper Smith about the over rate.
Short and wide outside off, Ali guides it towards the point region.
Ali gets to the line of the delivery outside off and defends it.
On the pads, Khan flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Younis prods forward to defend it.
Younis stays deep in his crease to defend it right in front of his eyes.
Teasing line outside off, Younis prods forward to defend it.
Ali stays deep in his crease to defend the last ball of the over.
Ali punches the back of a length delivery outside off through covers for a couple.
Good length delivery into the pads, Ali goes for a pull but is unable to make contact.
Length ball outside off, Ali punches it towards mid off.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and wide outside off, Ali drives it towards mid on where SOK makes a fine stop.
Younis lunges forward to defend it.

FOUR Overthrows! Tossed up outside off, Younis pushes it back to the bowler and the over excited Gary has a wild throw at the stumps. The bad throw raced towards the boundary beating both Wade and Smith.
Tossed up outside off, Ali prods forward and drives it towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Outside off, Ali plays a predetermined sweep shot through square leg for a boundary.
Floated outside off, Younis reaches out to it and flicks it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Younis leans forward to defend it.
Angling in from outside off, Ali shuffles across and presents the full face of the bat to defend it.
Short into the body, Ali pulls it uppishly towards square leg for a couple.
Back of a length delivery outside off, left alone.
Angling into the body, Ali stays deep in his crease to push it towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, Ali leans forward and pushes it towards covers.
Angled into the stumps, Ali drives it back dead straight down the ground. The fielder from mid on puts in a good dive to not give away a single.
Josh Hazlewood has a change of ends!
Floated outside off, Younis prods forward outside off to defend it.
Khan lunges forward to defend it.
Quicker through the air, Khan defends it on the on side.
Tossed outside off, Younis has reached out to the line of the delivery to defend it.
On the pads, Younis pushes it towards mid on.
Tossed up outside off, Younis drives it straight back to the bowler who makes a good stop towards his left.
Short and wide outside off, Khan taps it towards short covers for a really quick single.
Younis Khan pulls out at the last moment as he finds some disturbance near the sightscreen.
Angling into the pads, Ali pushes it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short outside off, Ali gets high on his toes to defend that one.
Back of a length delivery on the body, Ali has clipped it towards short leg.
Short and wide down the leg side, left alone.
Back of a length delivery on the body, Ali clips it towards square leg for a couple.
Tossed outside off, Khan comes down the track to defend it.
Khan prods forward to defend it.
Tossed up on the pads, Ali flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Ali glances it with the turn square leg.
Outside off, Khan drives it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Ali reaches out to the line of the ball and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Nathan Lyon into the attack now!
Dug in short, Khan ducks under it.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Short outside off, Khan has brilliantly guided it past point for a boundary.
Short outside off, Younis stays deep in his crease to defend it.

Run Out opportunity missed! Short and wide outside off, Younis taps it towards covers and calls for a quick single at first and denies it the very next moment. Azhar Ali was halfway down the pitch and Warner the fielder had three stumps to aim at but he misses them by a distance. He could have easily thrown it back to Starc who was quick to go back to the non-striker's end. An easy run-out chance goes abegging.
Sliding away from outside off, Younis pays no heed to the ball.
Short into the body, Younis gets on his toes and defends it in front of short leg.
Into the stumps, Ali leans forward and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Short and wide outside off, Ali pushes the ball towards the point fielder.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali defends it straight back to the ground on the on side.
Angling in from outside off, Azhar gets in line of the ball and punches it back to the bowler.
Angling into the pads, Ali drives it down the ground towards mid on.
Short and again into the body, Younis gets on his toes and pushes the ball towards the point region.
Short outside off, Younis Khan stands tall and deep in his crease to defend it from right in front of his eyes.
Angling into the pads, Younis flicks it towards fine leg for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Younis gets in line of the ball and defends it.
Full and fast on the middle, Younis Khan has somehow kept the ball at bay.
Angling into the pads, Younis flicks it through his pads for a couple towards square leg.
Mitchell Starc will bowl from the other end.
Back of a length into the stumps, Ali pushes it back to the bowler.
On a good length, Ali punches it towards covers.
On the pads, nudged towards square leg.
Full delivery outside off, Younis leans into the delivery and drives it through covers for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, Younis goes for a flick but is unable to make contact.
The players are out in the middle. Azhar Ali and Younis Khan have walked back out for Pakistan while Josh Hazlewood will start the proceedings for Australia.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3....

Perfect start for Australia with the ball. They have disrupted the visitors with a couple of quick blows. Pakistan have had a stuttering start with the bat as they look in discomfort in just 7 overs they have faced so far. Sharjeel Khan and Babar Azam were the ones who were dismissed in a fantastic over by Josh Hazlewood. Azhar Ali is looking good so let's see how long can he continue if he finds support. Join us in a while for the final session.
Tossed up delivery around middle, some bounce on it as Azhar Ali lunges forward and defends it down watchfully. TEA ON DAY 2!
Straightens a bit after landing as Azhar once again keeps it out.
Ali lunges forward and defends it down into the ground.
Silly point in place...
Loopy ball outside off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Floated ball around off, Azhar steps down the track and blocks it out.
Tossed up ball around off, Ali presses forward and defends it down.
Stephen O'Keefe is brought into the attack to bowl the final over before tea...
In the channel outside off, YK makes an easy leave to the keeper.
Strayed on the pads, it's tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Angles in a length ball from outside off, Azhar shoulders his arms to it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Good timing and it fetches a boundary to Azhar! Hazlewood goes too straight and Ali just tucks it through mid-wicket. Made good connection there as even a dive from the fielder couldn't prevent the boundary.
Risky to do that! Josh angles it in on middle, Ali gets across and flicks it towards mid-wicket. Had he missed it, he would have been dead plumb.

Short of a length ball on off, Ali taps it towards covers and calls for a quick single. Younis is running towards the danger end as there is a shy made by the fielder at his end. It misses and a single is completed.
Back of a length ball on middle, AA defends it off the back foot.
Touch fuller on middle, Ali stays behind the line and offers a full face of the blade but once again it goes towards the man at mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, driven straight to mid on.
Comes in with the angle, Ali clips it through mid-wicket to get another double to his name.
Starc keeps it full and serves it outside off, Ali leans into this one and drives it through extra cover for a couple.
Fuller in length and outside off, Younis Khan presses forward and defends it down safely.
Younis Khan walks in next, replacing Azam!

OUT! Azam bags a duck! Josh Hazlewood comes steaming in and angles it in on the middle. Babar Azam looks to work it across the line but is undone by the inward swing there. Is rapped flush on the pads and there goes a loud appeal for an LBW. The umpire immediately raises his finger to rule him out. Azam walks to Ali to ask if he should opt for the review. They take a bit more time and the umpire signals the time is up. Replays show it was in line and would have hit the stumps.
Good length ball on middle, defended with a straight bat.
Azam tries to push this full ball but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards point.
Angles a full length ball on middle, Babar Azam covers the line and defends it well.
Babar Azam is the new man in, replacing Sharjeel!

OUT! Edged and gone! Hazlewood draws first blood! On a length and angling across, Sharjeel Khan with no foot movement tries to drive it away and pays the price for the same. Gets a thick edge behind where Matthew Renshaw at first slip accepts a nice reverse cup catch at a chest height. Australia have gotten an early breakthrough.
Length ball outside off, Ali doesn't fiddle with it.
Fuller and angling in, pushed towards mid on off the crease.
In the channel outside off, Ali lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper.
Too full and served wide outside off, AA shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ali drives it towards mid off.
Sprays it full and outside off, Ali makes a good leave to the keeper.
Khan chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Flicked off the inner part of the bat towards mid on.
Can't say if that was a brave or a risky leave! Hazlewood hurls a length ball on off, it nips back in a touch as Sharjeel lets it go. The ball just goes over the timber.
Angles it in on the pads, SK looks to tuck it away but misses and is hit on the pads.

FOUR! Sharjeel Khan is off the mark in style! Sweet timing on that one! Fuller in length and just around off, the southpaw leans into it and shows the full face of the bat to get it past Warner at mid off. David gives it a chase but comes second best to the ball.
On a length and moving away a bit, Sharjeel has got nothing to do with that one.
Josh Hazlewood to share the new cherry from the other end!

A crowd catch from Nathan Lyon! Starc hurls a fuller length delivery outside off, Ali crouches low as he looks to jam it out on the off side. He does so and it goes on one bounce to Lyon at point who throws the ball and creates some excitement in the crowd.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ali shoulders his arms to it.
Pakistan are underway! Full and down the leg side, AA clips it through square leg for a comfortable couple.

Once again Starc misses the yorker and ends up slipping a full toss. Ali should have put it away but flicks it straight to the man at mid on. Some issue near the bowler's landing area and Starc isn't happy.
Slants it across the batsman, Azhar makes a good leave to the keeper.
Starts with a full toss delivery on the pads as he was looking to fire in a yorker. Gets it wrong as Ali pushes it towards mid-wicket.
